orders.thesis: Landstar gapped down 17.6% on a Q3 EPS miss driven by ~$0.47/sh insurance and claims items, while truck revenue per load is running +29% y/y in October with tight capacity and record BCO truck additions. Ex-items EPS ~$1.89 beat the $1.67 consensus; analyst targets remain $179-215 vs $139. Expect partial mean reversion as freight pricing flows through.
